title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering
author: Alex Chen
description: Motivation: Customers observed repeated regional failovers and thrashing during sustained regional latency spikes. Root cause analysis pointed to an ordering/race issue in the SLO enforcer backoff state machine combined with aggressive threshold resets which allowed a node to rapidly re-enter failover despite recent backoff. This PR fixes the ordering/race, introduces jittered backoff and hysteresis smoothing, adds metrics and tests, and provides a short-term rollout/monitoring plan. Change summary: - Ensure backoff state transitions are updated before triggering failover decisions (atomic commit ordering). - Add randomized jitter to backoff duration to prevent synchronized recovery across replicas. - Introduce a small hysteresis smoothing window on queue-length and p99 latency calculations to avoid flapping on short spikes. - Emit new metric SLOEnforcer.BackoffApplied{region,reason} and SLOEnforcer.FailoverDecision to improve observability. - Add unit and integration tests that reproduce the race condition and verify ordering and jitter behavior. - Add an emergency feature flag slo_enforcer.strict_ordering to enable rollback if needed. Rollout plan: 1) Canary rollout to 10% of traffic in us-east-1 for 2 hours with alerting on increased successful failovers and on SLOEnforcer.BackoffApplied rate. 2) Expand to 50% if stable for 12 hours. 3) Global rollout if no regressions for 24 hours. Monitoring: dashboards updated, alert thresholds relaxed briefly to reduce noise while we observe. Related: ENG-2345, ENG-2389. Checklist: - [x] Reproducing test case for the race - [x] Fix implementation with atomic ordering and jitter - [x] Metrics and dashboards - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Canary rollout plan and runbook
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): apply backoff state update before decision (atomic ordering)
feat(slo-enforcer): add jittered backoff and hysteresis smoothing
test(slo-enforcer): add unit/integration tests reproducing race and verifying ordering
chore(observability): add SLOEnforcer.BackoffApplied and FailoverDecision metrics, update dashboard
